description: This file defines the HttpException class within the Slim Framework, representing an HTTP-related exception with additional request context, and methods to set or get title and description.

classes.name: HttpException
classes.description: An exception class representing HTTP errors with associated request data and customizable title and description.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new HttpException with the request, message, code, and previous exception.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title associated with the exception.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets a new title for the exception.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description associated with the exception.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets a new description for the exception.
